channel.title: Global Fastener News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Fastener News (globalfastenernews.com)

item.title: OBITUARY: Austin Villarreal
item.description: 37-year-old fastener industry veteran worked as a key account manager for Sigma Fasteners.

item.title: MW Components Names Senior Marketing Manager
item.description: New marketing strategist joined MW Components in 2023 as Digital Marketing Strategist from R.E. Mason.

item.title: Fastenal Fastener Sales Strengthen
item.description: Direct fasteners/hardware sales increased in February, extending a record of fastener sales growth that began in July 2025 after two years of decline.

item.title: Fabory Acquires Metrik Fasteners BV
item.description: Deal strengthens Netherlands-based Fabory’s specialist support for customers across the Benelux petrochemical and energy markets.

item.title: FDI Edges Up in February
item.description: The Fastener Distributor Index modestly improved in February, reflecting "acceleration across sales and customer inventories."

item.title: EFDA: CBAM ‘Drastic’ Tariff on Fasteners
item.description: EFDA president demands immediate corrections to the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism to prevent cost hikes for EU products assembled with imported fasteners.

item.title: White Elected FIC Chair
item.description: Proferred Northeast regional manager was recently elected chair of the Fastener Industry Coalition.

item.title: Fastener Group Hires Supply Chain Manager
item.description: New manager brings over 14 years of fastener industry experience, including work for The Bolt Supply House Ltd.

item.title: Würth Group Leaving Kenya
item.description: After 29 years of operation, Würth Kenya will close at the end of May, when close to 500 Kenyans will be laid off.

item.title: Nickel Systems Expands in the South
item.description: “We’re investing directly in regional availability, faster response times, and stronger day-to-day support,” stated President Mike Taylor.
